summary: The rank-local rows are packed into warp jobs and submitted through a captured batch of up to 64 kernel launches. The timed host loop replays graph batches and launches residual iterations; emitted device code covers both independent-row and cooperative-lane job branches, with sparse loads, multiply/add accumulation, loop backedges, and output stores.

source_evidence.claim: The matrix builder establishes local CSR extents; packMatrix constructs row/job work; spmvGpu processes either stride jobs or cooperative jobs, traverses sparse entries and stores row output; main partitions rows by rank, derives jobs, captures batch calls, and times graph replays plus remainder launches for -i iterations.

compiled_evidence.claim: The compiled host captures repeated spmvGpu stubs into a graph with a counter/backedge, instantiates/uploads the graph, and in the timed region launches the graph in a counted loop plus stub launches for remainder iterations before stream synchronization.

compiled_evidence.claim: The emitted sm_86 spmvGpu body contains job selection, sparse global loads, double multiply/add operations, loop branches for the job's sparse work, and output stores for both job modes.

notes: No graph was instantiated or launched by this review. Source and existing host/device disassembly were inspected; runtime MPI coverage remains untested.

primary_quality_check.checked_examples: r2 source460-525,662-696 and host6901-6958,7016-7072 retain captured batchIterations kernels, floor(iterations/batchIterations) replays and remainder launches. r4 source682-749 and host6090-6170,5773-5843 retain the analogous up-to-64 batch/remainder identity. Device excerpts show sparse loads and real FP64 arithmetic for width/ordered and independent/cooperative paths; no model executed a graph.
